package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestCoursePlanNotificationRepositoryRejectsTransientPlannerPath(t *testing.T) {
	_, _, err := (CoursePlanNotificationRepository{}).Accept(context.Background(), domain.CoursePlanNotification{
		Outcome: domain.CoursePlanOutcome{
			EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", EventType: domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted,
			RequestID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CausationID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
			LearningPathID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", Status: domain.CoursePlanStatusCompleted,
			ResultCode: "COURSE_ASSIGNED", CourseID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
			Source: domain.CoursePlanSourceTeacher, Reason: "INITIAL",
		},
		PersonalTeacherID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888", Body: "ready",
		AcceptedAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 1, 12, 1, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	})
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidCoursePlanOutcome)
}
